breakdown.description: Labels the first FCC peak as (100), but the (100) reflection is forbidden for an FCC lattice. The first allowed FCC reflection is typically (111).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification continues to use the (100) reflection for the FCC lattice calculation, which is a forbidden reflection for FCC metals. The ground truth correctly identifies the first allowed FCC reflection as (111). The agent did not fix this inconsistency and instead carried forward the incorrect (100) indexing, leading to an incorrect lattice parameter calculation (≈2.08 Å instead of the correct ~3.59 Å for the (111) reflection).
